pieces.name: runtime
pieces.label: Runtime
pieces.description: The runtime: machines (boxes) and the containers (houses) an agent runs its work in.

pieces.name: secrets
pieces.label: Secrets
pieces.description: Secrets kept encrypted at rest (sops + age, which must be installed), handed to pieces and houses by name, never on argv.

pieces.name: shuttle
pieces.label: Shuttle
pieces.description: Chat bridges (Discord, Slack) and the household's model subscriptions: accounts, sign-ins, usage.

pieces.name: tasks
pieces.label: Tasks
pieces.description: A work store: tasks, links, comments and the ready queue.

pieces.name: approvals
pieces.label: Approvals
pieces.description: Single-use approvals: a body asks for one action, the owner allows or denies it on loom's Home, and it's spent once by exactly that action.

pieces.name: clock
pieces.label: Clock
pieces.description: Wakes an agent: self-set alarms, recurring schedules, the household's lanes assigned to an agent, and relays between agents, each run in a house or as a session here.

kinds._comment: A piece's tab kind when its manifest doesn't say (tab.kind): first-party pieces that are setup, not daily places.
